findings.message:
URL path punctuation can trigger keyword removal

The lookbehind omits `.`, so the new colon form matches the `fixes:` suffix in a URL such as `https://example.test/foo.fixes:#123`, publishing it as `https://example.test/foo.#123`. This violates the byte-preservation requirement for non-closing URLs; use robust URL/token detection and add a regression case.

summary: The sanitizer still rewrites some non-closing URLs.
